meta: Every week you write a report, you paste the same long instructions again? A Skill is like a recipe card: the steps, a layout template, sometimes sample files. Claude uses it automatically when needed.

muc.title: Repeating instructions every time
muc.text: Every week you write a report, and every time you paste the same long set of instructions. Skills let you give the instructions once.

muc.title: A recipe card
muc.text: A Skill is like a recipe card: the steps, a layout template, sometimes sample files too. Claude keeps it ready.

muc.title: It takes it out when needed
muc.text: When what you ask matches the card, Claude takes it out and follows it exactly. You don't need to remind it.

muc.title: Find it under Customize
muc.text: Go to Customize in the sidebar. Skills, Connectors and Plugins are all in one place. Click Discover to see the ready-made ones. The free plan can use them too.

muc.title: Bridges to Gmail, Drive, Calendar
muc.text: Connectors are bridges to Gmail, Google Drive or Google Calendar. Video 32 shows how to give permission safely.

muc.title: Turn on a ready-made skill
muc.text: Go to Customize, then Skills, and turn on a ready-made skill, like making slides or spreadsheets. Then ask Claude for exactly that task, and see how the result changes.

muc.title: Hand over a whole long task
muc.text: You have the tools. Part 6: hand Claude a whole long task, with Cowork.
